founders.title: From Regulatory Uncertainty to the Right Decision
founders.body: Founders need speed and clarity — not academic legal explanations. CompliHub360 turns regulatory complexity into decisions you can act on: what applies to your business, why it matters, and who can help. Expanding across borders is one of those decisions, not the only one.
founders.pain1Desc: Expanding internationally? VAT thresholds, EPR packaging laws, and GDPR differ by country. One missed registration can mean fines.
founders.pain2Desc: Cold-emailing compliance providers and waiting weeks for vague replies is not a strategy. It's a liability.
founders.pain3Desc: Our AI Wizard captures your context in 4–5 steps, maps jurisdiction-bound risks, and connects you to SLA-enforced specialists within 24–48h.
founders.diagramTitle: From context to the right specialist

operations.title: Centralize, Track & Master Compliance Ops
operations.body: Operations managers and agency operators need structured knowledge and a unified system — not scattered government sites and chaotic email threads. CompliHub360 gives you a single control center for cross-border compliance.
operations.card1Problem: Information on advertising restrictions, EPR, and tax laws is fragmented across unstructured government sites.
operations.card1Solution: Our Knowledge Hub aggregates source-backed laws, tutorials, and guides — all tailored to your exact search profile.
operations.card2Problem: Tracking provider requests, saved sessions, and legal updates is chaotic without a unified system.
operations.card2Solution: The Dashboard Control Center lets you save sessions, track engagement statuses in real-time, and monitor tasks.
operations.card3Problem: Summarizing regulatory exposure for stakeholders is manual, time-consuming work.
operations.card3Solution: One-click PDF export: Risk Snapshot, Action Plan, and Source Index — ready for internal circulation.

counsel.title: Defensible Intelligence. Secure Orchestration.
counsel.body: Legal professionals demand strict data privacy and zero AI hallucinations. CompliHub360 is a secure, EU-AI-Act ready infrastructure layer that accelerates legal research and safely structures external mandates.
counsel.benefit1Desc: Every summary, risk label, and tip is directly backed by links to official, validated legal sources and authorities. No invented claims.
counsel.benefit2Desc: Documents pass through a local PII Redaction Pipeline. Names, emails, and phone numbers are masked before any AI processing.
counsel.benefit3Desc: Replace vague emails with structured compliance dossiers sent to verified local counsel — accelerating the mandate process.

cta.title: Which role fits you?
cta.body: No matter your function — our platform adapts to your compliance reality.

engine.title: From Regulatory Uncertainty to Structured Action
engine.body: Compliance data is fragmented and unstructured. Our AI acts as a cognitive Advisory Layer — extracting your business intent and mapping it to concrete legal realities. No hallucinations. Every output grounded in verified sources.
engine.card1Body: You don't need to know which laws to search for. Our Wizard captures your context in 4–5 steps and generates a structured Search Profile automatically.
engine.card2Body: Before any document touches our AI, it passes through a local Redaction Pipeline — automatically masking PII like names, emails, and phone numbers.
engine.card3Body: The AI only activates if three strict conditions are met: document is sanitized, user has given explicit consent, and it's not classified as restricted.

matching.title: Verified Specialists. Orchestrated Accountability.
matching.body: We're not a directory. We're an orchestrator. We don't just give you a list of names — we control the engagement to ensure accountability, from first contact to successful resolution.
matching.step1Desc: Connects you only with specialists verified for your target country and compliance category.
matching.step2Desc: Your anonymized compliance dossier is sent directly to the partner — no cold emails, no blank inquiries.
matching.step3Desc: Partners must confirm receipt within 24h and reply within 48h. Our automated Watchdog enforces this.
matching.step4Desc: Repeated SLA breaches trigger an automatic downgrade. You only engage with responsive, top-tier professionals.
matching.step5Desc: High-performing partners earn priority placement and premium badges through our Ranking Engine.

coverage.title: Localized Security for Global Expansion
coverage.body: Your business crosses borders — your compliance should too. Every question, risk, and matched expert is tailored to the laws of your target market.
coverage.matrixBody: Data privacy laws differ across borders. Our platform adapts data residency, retention, and AI eligibility rules per jurisdiction — defaulting to strict GDPR standards for European markets.

partners.title: Pre-Qualified Clients. Zero Friction.
partners.body: Stop wasting billable hours on unqualified leads and unstructured cold emails. CompliHub360 sends you highly qualified, structured business clients ready to act.
partners.benefit1Desc: Receive business context, target markets, and specific regulatory risks — evaluate mandates instantly.
partners.benefit2Desc: Secure, time-bound one-click access. No portal to maintain, no password to remember.
partners.benefit3Desc: Transparent flat engagement fee. Great SLA performance earns priority placement and premium badges.

aiGov.heroDesc: We believe in responsible innovation. Our platform integrates AI strictly within the bounds of global regulations, ethics, and transparency. Discover how we implement the 6 dimensions of AI Governance.
aiGov.dimDesc: A comprehensive approach to building trustworthy AI systems for enterprise compliance.
aiGov.dimEthicsDesc: Our AI features respect human autonomy and are designed to augment professionals, not replace them. We prevent systemic bias through continuous monitoring.
aiGov.dimTranspDesc: Users deserve to know when they are interacting with AI. Every AI-generated output on CompliHub360 is clearly marked, and its data sources are traceable.
aiGov.dimOrgDesc: Clear governance pipelines dictate who can deploy, access, and audit AI features. We maintain comprehensive audit logs for all AI interactions.
aiGov.dimTechDesc: Our infrastructure ensures zero downtime and resilient fallbacks. Dedicated Privacy Gates sanitize all inputs before they reach any LLM.
aiGov.dimRegDesc: Built for the EU AI Act and ISO 42001. We map global standards directly into our Code, prioritizing strict EU and UK privacy rules.
aiGov.dimRiskDesc: Continuous risk assessment of AI models. We classify features by risk tiers (e.g., EU AI Act High-Risk vs. Minimal-Risk) and apply proportional security controls.
aiGov.featDesc: How we leverage AI today, wrapped in our strict governance framework.
aiGov.featPrivacyDesc: Before any business context is analyzed, our local NLP models strip out all Personally Identifiable Information (PII). Emails, names, and phone numbers never leave our secure European servers.
aiGov.featIntentDesc: Transforms unstructured client input into a structured risk profile. The AI is restricted to analyzing compliance context and cannot make binding legal decisions on its own.
aiGov.featGateDesc: Every AI action must pass three checks: Data Sanitization, Explicit Consent, and Domain Restriction. If any check fails, the workflow gracefully falls back to a deterministic, non-AI process.

behaviour.title: Professional first. Human always.
behaviour.lead: Governance describes the rules we hold ourselves to. This is what they mean once you actually use the product.
items: It says that it is AI. It never presents itself as a lawyer, accountant or customs specialist.
It explains in plain language — and names the technical term, so you learn it.
When the legal position is clear, it says so and explains why.
When it is uncertain, it says that too instead of guessing, and points you to qualified confirmation.
It never uses fear or urgency to move you towards a booking, and never invents an obligation.
It hands over to a person the moment professional judgement matters.
behaviour.principle: Technology should be the shortest path to the right human — not a barrier between them.

title.pre: From a question to someone who can

howItWorks.lead: Five steps. You can stop after any of them — most people do, and that is a perfectly good outcome.

stages.title: Ask in your own words.
stages.body: Describe your situation the way you would to a colleague. You get an answer with the source behind every point — the statute itself, not a summary of a summary. No account, no sales call, no obligation to go further.
stages.short: Ask in the free-text field — the answer carries the source behind every point. No account.

stages.title: See what actually applies to you.
stages.body: Four questions about your markets, your business model and your volume produce a risk map: the obligations that apply to your operation, each with its legal basis and its deadline. They come from our own compliance engine and link to the EU legal database — they are not generated by a chatbot.
stages.short: The wizard asks four things and builds your Risk Map — every obligation with legal basis and deadline.

stages.title: Decide what needs outside help.
stages.body: The map separates what you can handle in-house from what genuinely needs a specialist, and in what order. If it turns out you already have everything covered, we say so — there is nothing for us to sell you in that case.
stages.short: The Risk Map separates what you can handle internally from what needs a specialist.

stages.title: Quality before names.
stages.body: You first see the matched specialists without their identities: coverage, verified credentials, response time, fit with your markets. Judging the fit before the letterhead is deliberate — a familiar name is not evidence of the right fit. Ranking is never for sale.
stages.short: Specialists first without identity: coverage, verified qualifications, response time.

stages.title: Book, then hand over.
stages.body: Pick a time in the specialist’s calendar. Their identity is revealed at booking, along with a dossier of everything you have already told us, so you do not explain your business a sixth time. Afterwards you can review how it went, and the obligations stay on your map with their deadlines.
stages.short: Pick a slot — your dossier travels along, so you never explain your business a sixth time.

cost.body: The platform, the risk map and the matching are free for you. We are paid by the specialists when a booking actually happens. That is also why the ranking is not for sale: a paid position would make the match worthless to both sides.

privacy.body: You stay anonymous until you decide to create an account — the assessment needs neither name nor company nor e-mail address. A specialist sees your details only once you book, and your dossier is never shared without your instruction.

items.title: The assessment
items.desc: Four questions about your markets, your business model and your volume. No account, no sales call, no obligation to continue.

items.title: Your risk map
items.desc: The duties that apply to your operation, each with its legal basis and its deadline. A free account opens the full map.

items.title: The comparison
items.desc: Coverage, verified qualifications, response time and fit to your markets — side by side, before any identity is revealed.

who.title: The specialists, on booking.
who.body: A specialist is charged when a confirmed appointment comes out of a match — not for being listed, not per click, not for a profile view. At no point is anything charged to you.

ranking.title: The ranking.
ranking.body: Placement is never for sale. A paid position would make the match worthless for both sides: you would meet whoever paid the most, and the specialist would meet someone whose case they cannot serve. Suitability is the only input.

specialist.title: Their fee — quoted before you commit.
specialist.body: The advice itself is not free, and we will not pretend otherwise. Every Verified Partner publishes a fixed estimate before you accept the engagement, so you never sit through a discovery call just to learn the price.

faq.title: What visitors ask before they start.

items.q: What does CompliHub360 live on, then?
items.a: On the specialists: one is charged when a confirmed appointment comes out of a match — not for being listed, not per click, not for a profile view.

items.q: Can a specialist buy a better position?
items.a: No. Placement is never for sale — a paid position would make the match worthless for both sides. Fit is the only criterion.

items.q: What does the specialist's advice cost?
items.a: The specialist sets the fee: every Verified Partner publishes a fixed estimate before you accept the engagement — you never sit through a first call just to learn the price.

items.q: Does the specialist see my details before I book?
items.a: No. You compare anonymously; only when you send a request does the chosen specialist receive your structured search profile.

about.lead: Compliance decisions are easier when you understand what actually applies to your business — and when the platform helping you has no reason to sell you something you do not need.

why.statement: Businesses making important decisions deserve someone genuinely on their side.
why.body: CompliHub360 was created after years of seeing the same problem: businesses had access to many providers, but no neutral place to understand their needs before entering a sales conversation. We exist to put clarity, knowledge and choice first.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.body: To empower businesses to make informed decisions with confidence, always putting their needs first.

mission.title: Mission
mission.body: To empower businesses everywhere to understand and manage their compliance needs through reliable knowledge, intuitive technology and access to the right professionals — supporting them throughout their entire business journey.

vision.title: Vision
vision.body: To become the place businesses around the world turn to first for compliance — creating a more transparent industry where knowledge empowers better decisions, quality drives competition, and businesses and professionals build meaningful, long-term relationships.

items: We do not create needs. We identify them.
Experience is how trust is delivered.

about.close: The complexity belongs to us. The simplicity belongs to you.
